name: Amanda Anisimova
hometown: Freehold Township, New Jersey, United States
intro: Amanda Anisimova is an American star from New Jersey. She hits one of the hardest backhands in tennis. Last year she reached the US Open final in New York!
story: Amanda started tennis at age five. She copied her big sister Maria. At 17 she reached the semifinals of the French Open. Then she took a break from tennis to rest her mind. She came back stronger than ever and climbed to No. 3 in the world.

funFacts.text: She won the US Open junior title in 2017. She beat Coco Gauff in the final!
She loves to paint. She sold her paintings in a New York gallery to help charities.
Her favorite artist is Vincent van Gogh.
During her break, she fostered a dog. She took road trips with friends.
During her time off, she went to college in Florida for a semester.
Her parents moved from Russia to America before she was born.
She won two big titles in 2025, in Qatar and Beijing.

watchFor: Watch her two-handed backhand. She crushes it flat and hard. It often lands right on the line.
